items.title: 22.6.2 Reactions of the Aromatic Ring in Phenols (phenol ki ring ke reactions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.6.2 with Quick Check 22.5 answered, printed pages 93-94 (PDF 96-97).

blocks.text: Phenol mein hydroxyl (-OH) group benzene ring se jura hota hai. Is hydroxyl group ka oxygen atom ring mein electron density deta hai. Oxygen ka ek lone pair benzene ring ke π system se overlap kar ke phail (delocalise ho) jata hai, aur aromatic ring mein electron density barh jati hai. Barhi hui electron density ki wajah se ring par electrophile (electron ka bhooka group) ka attack aasan ho jata hai; ring activated (zyada reactive) ho jata hai. Phenol ka hydroxyl group aane wale electrophiles ko 2, 4 aur 6 positions par bhejta hai.

Room temperature par dilute nitric acid (HNO₃) se phenol electrophilic substitution karta hai aur 2-nitrophenol aur 4-nitrophenol ka mixture banta hai. Concentrated HNO₃ istemal karein to is ki jagah 2,4,6-trinitrophenol banta hai. Benzene ring ka ek hydrogen atom nitro (-NO₂) group se badal jata hai. Isay phenol ki nitration kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Do reactions, dono phenol se, room temperature par. 2 phenol dilute HNO3(aq) se 2-nitrophenol + 4-nitrophenol ('mixture of products formed') + 2H2O. Phenol conc. HNO3(aq) se 2,4,6-trinitrophenol + 3H2O.
blocks.caption: Dilute aur concentrated nitric acid se phenol ki nitration (kitab ke PDF page 96 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono reactions phenol hi se shuru hote hain: dilute nitric acid ek -NO₂ group 2 ya 4 position par lagata hai (do products ka mixture), jab ke concentrated nitric acid teen -NO₂ groups (2, 4 aur 6) ek saath laga deta hai.

Benzene ki nitration ke liye concentrated nitric acid (HNO₃) aur sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄) ka mixture benzene ke saath 25°C aur 60°C ke darmiyan reflux karna parta hai. Phenol zyada reactive hai, is liye us ki nitration milder (narm) conditions mein, room temperature par dilute nitric acid se ho jati hai. Concentrated nitric acid istemal ho to 2,4,6-trinitrophenol banta hai.

Room temperature par bromine water se bhi phenol electrophilic substitution karta hai. Phenol orange bromine solution ka colour uda deta hai (decolourise karta hai) aur 2,4,6-tribromophenol ka white (safaid) precipitate (neeche baithne wala solid) banta hai. Isay phenol ki bromination kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Phenol + 3Br2 (orange solution), arrow ke oopar room temperature, se 2,4,6-tribromophenol (white precipitate), positions 2, 4 aur 6 par Br, + 3HBr.
blocks.caption: Phenol ki bromination (kitab ke PDF page 97 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Benzene ki bromination sirf pure (khalis) bromine se hoti hai (solution se nahi), aur room temperature par anhydrous (paani ke baghair) aluminium bromide (AlBr₃) catalyst chahiye. Phenol is ke muqable mein catalyst ke baghair bromine water se aasani se react kar leta hai.
Phenol (C₆H₅OH) ke ilawa bhi bohat se phenolic compounds hain. Ek misaal 1-naphthol hai.

blocks.alt: 1-naphthol: do jure benzene rings, position 1 par OH. Ring ki positions bahar ki taraf 1 se 8 tak, aur 9 aur 10 dono shared (saanjhe) carbons par.
blocks.caption: 1-naphthol aik phenolic compound hai (kitab ke PDF page 97 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Naphthalene ki positions 1 se 8 bahar ki taraf hain; 9 aur 10 woh do carbons hain jo dono rings mein shared (saanjhe) hain aur un par H nahi, is liye wahan substitution nahi hoti.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab ne structure ke neeche label '1-naphtol' chhapa hai.
Sahi spelling: 1-naphthol.

1-naphthol mein hydroxy group naphthalene ki position 1 par jura hai. Phenol ki tarah 1-naphthol ka -OH group bhi electron deta hai aur naphthalene ring ko electrophilic substitution ke liye activate karta hai. Electrophiles 2 aur/ya 4 positions par jate hain. 9 aur 10 positions par substitution possible (mumkin) nahi, kyunke un carbons par hydrogen atom nahi. 1-naphthol aur doosre phenolic compounds phenol ki tarah hi react karte hain.

blocks.alt: Numbered 1-naphthol, arrow ke oopar Br2 aur neeche CH3COOH, se 2-bromo-1-naphthol + 4-bromo-1-naphthol.
blocks.caption: 1-naphthol ki bromination (kitab ke PDF page 97 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ethanoic acid (CH₃COOH) mein Br₂ se 1-naphthol ki bromination: Br position 2 par lage to 2-bromo-1-naphthol, position 4 par lage to 4-bromo-1-naphthol.

blocks.prompt: a) Phenol ki pehchan (identification) ke liye us ka bromine water se reaction use hota hai. Reaction mein kya visual change (nazar aane wali tabdeeli) hoti hai, aur banne wale compound ka systematic naam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Orange bromine water ka colour ur jata hai (decolourise) aur white (safaid) precipitate banta hai; product 2,4,6-tribromophenol hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Nitration aromatic electrophilic substitution hai aur is ka rate ring par pehle se maujood group par depend karta hai. Benzene aur phenol mein se kaun aasani se nitrate hota hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Phenol: oxygen ka lone pair ring mein delocalise ho kar electron density barhata hai, is liye ring NO₂⁺ jaise electrophiles ke liye zyada reactive hai; room temperature par dilute nitric acid kaafi hai, jab ke benzene ko concentrated HNO₃ aur H₂SO₄ chahiye.

blocks.prompt: c) 1-naphthol ki nitration ki reaction equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: C₁₀H₇OH + HNO₃ → HOC₁₀H₆NO₂ + H₂O; dilute HNO₃ se 2-nitro-1-naphthol aur 4-nitro-1-naphthol bante hain (us ki bromination ki tarah 2 aur 4 positions par).

items: -OH group ring ko activate karta hai aur electrophiles ko 2, 4 aur 6 positions par bhejta hai.
Dilute HNO₃ (room temperature): 2- aur 4-nitrophenol; concentrated HNO₃: 2,4,6-trinitrophenol.
Bromine water: orange colour urta hai, white 2,4,6-tribromophenol (phenol ka test); benzene ko pure Br₂ aur AlBr₃ chahiye.
1-naphthol bhi isi tarah 2 aur/ya 4 positions par react karta hai.
